about: Aptus Value Housing Finance India Ltd is a Home Loan Company. Aptus has been formed to primarily address the housing finance needs of self-employed, low and middle income families primarily from semi-urban and rural areas. Company targets first-time home buyers where collateral is self- occupied residential property.
